title: A Multi-Agent Framework for Medical AI: Leveraging Fine-Tuned GPT, LLaMA, and DeepSeek R1 for Evidence-Based and Bias-Aware Clinical Query Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Rule-based scanning of generated medical responses against a predefined database of sensitive medical terms, absolutist language, and phrases associated with medical misinformation or implicit judgments.

Applying fine-tuned sentiment classification models to assess whether generated medical responses exhibit overly positive, negative, or alarmist emotional tones rather than maintaining neutral and factual professional language.

Using Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to identify which input terms, symptoms, or patient characteristics disproportionately influence the model's clinical conclusions.
